title: Consolidate MongoDB Collections for Orleans Event Sourcing Provider
body:
# User Story
As a system operator of Aevatar,  
**I want** all grains of the same type to share a single MongoDB collection for event sourcing logs,  
**so that** the number of MongoDB collections grows predictably (per grain type) instead of explosively (per grain instance),  
**enabling** sustainable cluster maintenance and reduced operational complexity.

# Details & Requirements
- New Collection Schema Design: all events for a grain type MUST persist in a single collection named by `[GrainType]` (e.g., from `testServiceId/LogStorage/log/Aevatar.Core.Tests.TestGAgents.publishing/29ba9cdacfae4ffb816860bf8602cc1f`to `testServiceId/LogStorage/log/Aevatar.Core.Tests.TestGAgents.publishing`).
- Required Indexes: it should be easy to read logs of a single GAgent from the new collection via its GrainId

# Acceptance Criteria
- `Aevatar.EventSourcing.MongoDB` can create a single collection for the same grain type.
- Unit test cases.
